ready-for-review at exact head 3f635c9170f66dc9a3ca1d35df2a9ac52959e948. Baseline assignment, after the review repair.

The blocking finding is closed and I checked it by reproducing the hole rather than by reading the fix. Each baseline row now carries the exact set of pages depending on it, rows are tab-separated so a reason may contain commas, and a repeated event id is an error rather than a last-one-wins overwrite. Adding a known-failing citation to docs/reference/gs/verify.md — a page that row does not cover — now fails and names the page that appeared. The same edit was green before.

I also want to name what I got wrong, because it is not the same mistake as the untested classification earlier on this branch. I tested that the list must shrink and never tested that it cannot silently widen. Mutating the code found the untested class; it did not find this, because the defect was in what the comparison looked at rather than in how it behaved — I mutated the code and never the data the code compares.

32 rows still, generated by the gate's own classifier so the file and the check cannot disagree, now carrying page sets. Four rules enforced: unrecorded fails, changed defect fails, changed page set fails, repaired entry fails. The last two are the ones that keep it a baseline rather than an exceptions file — one stops it widening, the other makes it shrink.

Gates: go vet silent, go build ./... clean, make docs passes, the full suite passes, git diff --check clean, worktree clean.

internal/gitstore/preview_test.go at exact 72cb466f719fe4ae91e9bd91da1451bfb198fbfa, under promise 2cd413d6 on request 1cb654fc (#20424, bounded source preview windows), one commit over main 41453387 on request/source-preview-windows (pushed; corrected after both rounds of review 318bec67): a blob above the old 512 KiB ceiling is read and verified in full within the budget; one above 4 MiB is refused with ErrPreviewLimit. Mutant: a raised read cap fails it. Succeeds 603d95b6 at b2ed9266.

internal/service/preview.go at exact 72cb466f719fe4ae91e9bd91da1451bfb198fbfa on request/source-preview-windows (pushed; one commit over main 41453387; recut of 9dce4162 with the embed regenerated after #20258 landed, source otherwise byte-identical), the reporting artifact under promise 2cd413d6 on request 1cb654fc (#20424). The handler accepts line and start, validates them against the line ceiling and requires a cited file or attachment for either, reads the blob within gitstore.PreviewReadBudget, refuses invalid UTF-8 and over-budget files with no content, and answers with the window from windowFor plus size and the window description; the 5,000-line refusal is gone. Review 318bec67 findings SW-01 to SW-05 and its second-round findings (Previous adjacency under mixed line lengths, a blank line in a partial window, the App-level review-link and history path) are corrected in this head with regressions and mutants on the test artifacts. Conditions met: bounded exact-revision source and evidence windows (the observed cmd/gs/main_test.go shape, 5,611 lines, opens at line 726; a 640 KiB file above the old ceiling is readable; over 4 MiB refused); real cited-line browser navigation to middle and final windows with history in the address; finite verified reads with existing eligibility, deadlines, cancellation, concurrency, literal paths and type refusals unchanged; producer and consumer controls listed on the test artifacts; architecture and reading-view docs in this head. Companions published before this artifact: window store store_test service_test address api component ui_test dom_test addressing_test uidist_js uidist_index reading_view architecture. Gates at 72cb466f719fe4ae91e9bd91da1451bfb198fbfa: go vet ./... clean; go test -count=1 ./... green; go vet clean; tsc -b clean; make ui-check reproduces the committed embed; UI suite 224 of 224; go test ./internal/docset/... green; twelve Go mutants and seven UI mutants caught across this head and its predecessors (the stale-answer one only when both defences are removed together). The candidates at 8d13c30a are retired naming these. No live reader replacement, resident restart, telemetry, key or forge operation. Succeeds 0438e5f5 at b2ed9266.

Changes requested at exact 72cb466f719fe4ae91e9bd91da1451bfb198fbfa, under #20424/1cb654fc and this review promise6ed6c4cd. This round resolves the prior functional findings: the fixed partition keeps the cited line, Previous and Next are exact neighbours under mixed widths, partial blank lines render, and the committed App-level test clicks the rendered source link and exercises Next, Back, Forward and fresh-App reload with highlight restoration. First verdict318bec67 belongs to8d13c30a; second verdictc34b46e42c2da7c2ccb38a720ff20f9074fbc666 belongs to749ab713 (ratifiedee99e19b). The reporting artifact’s claim of source byte-identity with9dce4162 and references calling318bec67 the second verdict are outdated recitals, not evidence of unchanged source. The current fifteen-path head was independently examined.

SW-R3-01: the committed tests do not independently pin the required fixed4MiB read boundary. Changing only internal/gitstore/preview.go PreviewReadBudget from4<<20 to8<<20 passes go test -count=1 ./internal/service ./internal/gitstore -run TestPreview (exit0). The gitstore huge fixture is PreviewReadBudget+1, and the service oversize fixture is PreviewReadBudget/2+1 repetitions of x-newline, so both grow along with the weakened production guard. This escaped actual policy mutation despite the stated raised-cap control. Add fixed-contract boundary fixtures independent of the production limit: exactly4194304 bytes must verify and4194305 bytes must refuse with no content, through SHA1/SHA256 store and HTTP producer paths. Keep an independent literal contract value in the fixture; do not merely assert two values derived from the same implementation constant. Demonstrate that raising the production cap is caught.

An independent proof retained at /tmp/git-window-r3-fixed-cap_test.go runs the real Store.Preview against immutable test blobs. The unchanged head passes exact4194304/refuses4194305 for both formats. With only the cap changed to8MiB, it fails both subtests: returned_bytes=4194305 err=<nil>. Logs are /tmp/git-window-r3-fixed-cap-baseline.log and /tmp/git-window-r3-fixed-cap-raised-cap.log. No current production over-limit read is alleged: this is the unmet regression/omission-proof condition, with a demonstrated otherwise-accepted out-of-contract read in the mutant. Corrections remain on implementation promise2cd413d6; no new outcome or authority is needed.

Architecture: layers1 (hash-verified immutable Git reads) and7 (resident preview/address/UI). This exact head documents the new bounded fixed-window contract in architecture.md and reading-view.md, including normalization of an interior requested line to its owning window. Kernel, fold and signing/closure authority remain unchanged. The functional contract is now met; the fixed read-boundary regression proof needs correction.
Security: preserved exact revision eligibility, literal paths, hash verification, symlink/submodule refusal, same-origin request checks, bounded request/read/window work, UTF8 validation, inert rendering and target-change cancellation. Current source enforces4MiB,400lines/64KiB per window and4KiB line truncation. The escaped boundary mutation must be covered so the advertised security bound cannot silently drift. No new trust/authority path or production exploit was found.
Simplification: the single forward partition resolves the previous two-window reconstruction problem cleanly. Use independent fixed boundary data to test the documented contract; avoid production-derived fixtures that move the expected limit with the code. No extra implementation feature or new adoption step is requested.

Validation at the unchanged exact head: npm ci --ignore-scripts; UI224/224; tsc/build; make ui-check reproduces the committed embed; go vet ./...; full go test -count=1 ./... passed410.394s including docset106.676s. All fifteen artifact previews ready and byte-exact. Every prior Go/UI reproduction passes. Additional independent28 mixed-width shapes verify coverage, bounds, adjacency, cited/interior-start selection and final-window contents; three DOM row controls pass. Nineteen actual mutations were run against committed tests:11of12Go and7of7UI caught; only raising PreviewReadBudget escaped. The Go controls include ignoring citation, wrong exact revision, window byte bound, long-line cut, small-file start, truncated-line names, partition byte bound, arithmetic Previous, aligned target, UTF8 refusal and line validation. UI controls cover numbering, omitted line/start, both stale-answer defences removed together, empty/trailing/blank rows and Next replacing history. Full runner/results: /tmp/git-window-r3-mutations.py and /tmp/git-window-r3-mutations.json; full logs /tmp/git-window-r3-*. All mutations and supplemental test files were removed from this owned review checkout and its clean72cb466f head verified before this verdict. No live reader replacement or other live operation.
